name: Zoom Realtime Media Streams Meeting Provider
description: A meeting-participant provider for Zoom through Realtime Media Streams: no participant joins the meeting; your own Zoom app streams the meeting's audio to a media worker, which publishes it into a LiveKit room.

extensions.displayName: Zoom Realtime Media Streams Meeting Provider

features: Starts a Realtime Media Streams stream for a person who is in the meeting as its host, an alternative host or an invitee, through their own OAuth connection
Verifies Zoom's webhook signature and answers its endpoint validation
A media worker that holds each stream's signaling and media connections and publishes the mixed audio into a LiveKit room only when told to capture
The active speaker's name on a LiveKit text topic, for transcript labels
Stops by Zoom's own controls, a stop link, or the owner; an unrequested stream is closed at once
OAuth for a user-managed app with token refresh, rotation and a Postgres token store
